description: Renovate is off in this repository. buddy-bot owns dependency updates - AGENTS.md says so, and .github/workflows/buddy-bot.yml is what implements it.

Running both produced the same pull request twice (web-ext as #2194 and #2195, all-non-major as #1825 and #2202) and a second dependency dashboard in #1, each pair burning a full CI matrix and needing a human to pick a winner (stacksjs/stacks#2574).
This file stays rather than being deleted: with no config at all Renovate falls back to its own defaults and starts again the moment the app installation is present.
